title: Classify realm and frame before comparing occupancy
trigger: realm space frame portal dungeon cellar mine occupancy adjacency collision local coordinates
guidance: Establish physical realm/instance and space/frame identity before treating coordinates as neighbors. Same-realm buildings, ordinary cellars and designated mines share coherent volume. An explicit magical portal may connect independently framed realms; only its local endpoint consumes host space. A dungeon label or matching XYZ does not select the realm. Keep canonical transition/return semantics separate from geometry transforms and generation policy.

evidence.note: Inspected guidance explicitly distinguishes intended domains from runtime API implementation.

recheck: The referenced document is design guidance, not proof of complete realm/portal APIs or migration. Reconcile current identity and persistence contracts; never use a portal label to excuse contradictory geometry within either realm.
